caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular section of patterned textile or wallpaper with a color palette dominated by various shades of blue and white. The central motif features a bird, drawn in dark and medium blues, perched on a small pedestal, holding a shield-shaped object with vertical stripes. Behind the bird, there is a large, striped column adorned with stylized leafy decorations at the top. The background and surrounding area are filled with dense floral designs, including large blossoms and leafy branches, rendered with alternating light and dark blue tones to create contrast and depth. The design is bordered by vertical blue bands to the left and right, suggesting a repeated textile pattern. The drawing is placed on an off-white or cream background, with a hand-written scale “seven six inch” beneath the depicted textile sample.
title: Textile
